$comment: Draw order and sources. Array order IS render order - earlier entries draw underneath. Add a layer by dropping a file in style/layers/ and adding its name here.
$comment_order: Trees sit above the paths (canopy overhangs a walk) but below the buildings, so drawn structures stay legible rather than being covered by forest.
$comment_sources: One GeoJSON source per layer file, produced by pipeline/classify.py. At 1.3 MB total, MapLibre renders these directly - no vector tiles needed at estate scale. NOTE: keys inside `sources` become MapLibre sources verbatim, so no $comment keys belong in here. (Hillshade terrain was removed deliberately - the map is flat 2D artwork.)
$comment_glyphs: External font service. Self-host before production - this is a third-party dependency in the render path.
$comment_sprite: Generated by pipeline/sprite.py from pipeline/rules/sprite.json. Patterns are referenced as pat-<name>, icons as icon-<name>. No extension - MapLibre appends .png/.json and @2x itself.
$comment_view: Initial camera. Historic core, matching the prototype's opening view.
